correctness.rationale: With positive iid categorical probabilities, exact count of positive-prefix occupancies gives F_i(t)=p_i(t-1)![z^{t-1}]prod_{r != i}(exp(p_r z)-1). Factors p^k/k!, k>=1, are log-concave with interval support and convolution preserves Toeplitz TP2. The determinant expansion into k<l pairs has nonnegative terms; k=w-m+2,l=k+1 (or k=w,l=v for m=2) gives a strictly positive witness for every w<v. Positive row normalization gives strict LR order, then strict stochastic/mean order; symmetry proves equal-weight case. All quantifiers, boundary m=2 and t=m covered. Bundled checker verifies 30,533 finite exact assertions but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A collector observes the final coupon identity C as a natural marker of heterogeneous coverage difficulty. The theorem identifies a sharp and distribution-wide association: conditional on C, every completion-time quantile and increasing risk functional is ordered by that coupon's frequency, with strict likelihood ratios rather than only expected times. It provides a reusable global structural law across arbitrary finite probability vectors and all times; the key marked determinant is not a routine calculation of one tabulated sample size.
